issues.observed: The first inventory wrapper placed a foreach expression directly inside a pipeline and failed before any repository probe completed.
issues.recovery: Materialize the foreach results into a scalar collection before piping or serializing them.
issues.recurrence_guard: Never place an empty or syntactically ambiguous foreach expression at a PowerShell pipeline boundary.

issues.observed: A schema-reading batch assumed positional PowerShell arguments that were not supplied, so four requested reads failed before opening.
issues.recovery: Use explicit literal paths in a bounded loop and verify every selected file reaches EOF.
issues.recurrence_guard: Bind every batched schema path explicitly rather than relying on transport-specific positional arguments.

issues.observed: The first manifest verifier used python -c and Windows native argument processing stripped inner quotes, producing a syntax error.
issues.recovery: Pass multiline verifier source over standard input to python -.
issues.recurrence_guard: Use stdin for quote-rich multiline Python diagnostics on Windows.

issues.observed: A clean-state wrapper used an invalid parenthesized PowerShell command form and failed before Git status completed.
issues.recovery: Capture each Git command result and exit code in scalar variables before object projection.
issues.recurrence_guard: Separate native command execution from PowerShell expression grouping.

issues.observed: The first keyword audit completed its file search but failed while printing a Māori title through the CP1252 console.
issues.recovery: Set UTF-8 output explicitly and rerun only the read-only display layer.
issues.recurrence_guard: Use UTF-8 console output before rendering Unicode repository text.

issues.observed: A generic-builder search passed Unix-style path wildcards directly to rg on Windows and matched no intended files.
issues.recovery: Use rg -g glob filters rooted at the exact repository path.
issues.recurrence_guard: Use ripgrep glob arguments rather than shell-expanded Unix wildcards on Windows.

issues.observed: A route-hash probe embedded a PowerShell backtick inside a JavaScript template literal and failed before hashing.
issues.recovery: Use literal command strings without JavaScript template interpolation and hash the exact Git blob separately.
issues.recurrence_guard: Keep PowerShell escape syntax out of JavaScript template delimiters.

issues.observed: A second route probe used a PowerShell revision variable form that JavaScript attempted to interpolate before execution.
issues.recovery: Pass the exact revision and repository-relative path as literal command arguments.
issues.recurrence_guard: Avoid cross-language variable sigils in nested command transport.

issues.observed: The first supplemental stale-label wrapper lost a nested PowerShell quote terminator before ripgrep executed and earned zero scan credit.
issues.recovery: Pass each stale-label token as a separate literal ripgrep -e pattern.
issues.recurrence_guard: Avoid one composite quoted regex when command transport spans JavaScript, PowerShell, and ripgrep.
